checklist: ADD new section § Structure Factor Grid Construction to spec-db-core.md (after § Core Data Types)
§ build_structure_factor_grid() Contract:
- Input: indices array (n_refl, 3) int, amplitudes array (n_refl,) float, device (torch.device), halo (bool)
- Output tuple: (grid tensor, metadata dict, asu_map tensor)
- Grid shape: (h_range, k_range, l_range) with bounds computed from indices ± halo_width
- halo_width SHALL be 1 when halo=True, 0 otherwise (REFINE-005)
- Metadata dict SHALL contain keys: h_min, h_max, k_min, k_max, l_min, l_max, has_halo, n_unique_asu
- asu_map SHALL map Miller indices to canonical ASU via Friedel-pair canonicalization
- SCALE-001: Amplitudes SHALL NOT be scaled (pass-through to grid)
ADD new section § Calibration Metadata (after § Structure Factor Grid Construction)
§ load_calibration_metadata() Contract:
- Input: config_json_path (str or Path)
- Output dict: spot_scale_override, beam_flux, beam_exposure, beamsize_mm (optional), N_cells (optional)
- SHALL raise FileNotFoundError if file does not exist
- SHALL raise KeyError if crystal.scale_override, beam.flux, or beam.exposure missing
- SHALL raise ValueError if spot_scale_override <= 0 or beam values non-positive
§ load_refined_mtz() Contract:
- Input: mtz_path (str or Path), column (str, default 'F')
- Output tuple: (indices array int32, amplitudes array float32)
- SHALL raise FileNotFoundError if mtz_path does not exist
- SHALL raise ImportError if iotbx.mtz unavailable
- SHALL raise ValueError if column not found or invalid MTZ format
